Question 4

Let C be the set of all multiples of 2 greater than 0 and let D be the set of all multiples of 3 greater than 0. What is D−C?

a
 {2,4,8,10,14,16,20,22,26,…}
b
 {6,12,18,24,…}
c
 {2,3,4,8,9,10,14,15,16,…}
d
 {3,9,15,21,…}
e
 {2,3,4,6,8,9,10,12,14,…}
